purpose: Validate declared provenance for realization arrows and promotion dependencies without inferring ontology.

promotion_policy.source_constructor: eligible only after evidence locator resolution and applicable completion checks
promotion_policy.explicit_assumption: typed conditional use allowed; realization promotion refused
promotion_policy.observer_fitted: fit/scout use allowed; realization promotion refused

dependency_policy: Every dependency of a requested realization promotion is checked recursively as a declaration. One ineligible dependency refuses the promotion.
claim_boundary: This gate validates declarations and evidence presence. It does not infer whether an arrow is physically source-derived, prove evidence contents, or construct missing ontology.
